name: claude-code-docs
description: The Claude Code Docs as a plugin: an MCP server and a skill that answer questions about Claude Code 2.1.311.

plugins.name: cc-docs
plugins.description: MCP server and skill for the Claude Code Docs (version 2.1.311). Search and read pages, list sections, and get the JSON Schemas (search_docs, read_page, list_pages, get_schema). The first three also search, read, and list the Claude API and platform docs (source "platform"). Live fetch with an offline disk cache.

plugins.name: cc-docs-cli
plugins.description: The Claude Code Docs (version 2.1.311) as a cc-docs command (search, read, list, schema) that the Bash tool runs, plus a light skill. No MCP server, so it adds no tool list to the context. Works only in Claude Code. Needs Bun.

plugins.name: cc-inspect
plugins.description: MCP server and skill that read your Claude Code session transcripts (list, read, search, and check them against the transcript schema) and the code inside the installed Claude Code binary (list installs and modules, search, read, resolve object literals and OpenTelemetry events, list the built-in tools with what gates them, list the surface by kind: env vars, flags, settings, gates, errors, and more, diff two versions by function, and run a prompt offline against a local fake API to see the text the program sends), in 4 tools. Local, except the release notes (gh) and the readable view (bunx @wakaru/cli); writes only its cache of cleaned code and temp folders it removes.
